description: Read the text of a note on sharenotes.dev, given its link (https://sharenotes.dev/blue-fox-42) or just its name (blue-fox-42). Use it when the user gives you a ShareNotes link and asks about its contents. Notes written in the ShareNotes web editor are returned as HTML. It does not open PIN-protected notes, and it does not open delete-after-reading notes, because opening one destroys it — for those, ask the user to open the link in a browser.

note.description: The note link, e.g. https://sharenotes.dev/blue-fox-42, or just blue-fox-42.

name: read_note
title: Read a ShareNotes note
